name: garrison-live
description: Frozen snapshot of the configuration Garrison ships: the quick start manifest (examples/multi-agent.yaml) and the sample agents and deployments the Kubernetes bootstrap Job applies (k8s/base/manifests), substituted as the bootstrap does with no credentials.
source: Frozen snapshot of examples/multi-agent.yaml, k8s/base/manifests/agents.yaml, k8s/base/manifests/deployment-claude.yaml, k8s/base/manifests/deployment-codex.yaml, k8s/base/manifests/deployment-mux.yaml on 2026-10-11, substituted as the bootstrap Job does, built by Garrison.Benchmark generate --kind live from benchmarks/datasets/live/sources.json.

corpora.description: Load the shipped configuration and check it reads back.

items.name: claude-credential
items.manifest:
apiVersion: garrison/v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: claude-credential
  description: Claude Code credential for the quick start agents
spec:
  kind: ClaudeCodeOAuthToken

items.name: codex-credential
items.manifest:
apiVersion: garrison/v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: codex-credential
  description: Codex credential for the quick start agents
spec:
  kind: CodexAuthJson

items.name: planner
items.manifest:
apiVersion: garrison/v1
kind: Agent
metadata:
  name: planner
  description: Breaks a request into steps and hands coding work to other agents
spec:
  displayName: Planner
  exposure: { a2a: true, mcpTool: true }
  # Without a mode, a non-empty allow list means AllowList. researcher is the Mux agent the quick start
  # creates in the dashboard; naming an agent that does not exist yet is fine.
  delegation:
    allow: [coder, echo, researcher]
    maxDepth: 1

items.name: coder
items.manifest:
apiVersion: garrison/v1
kind: Agent
metadata:
  name: coder
  description: Writes and explains code
spec:
  displayName: Coder
  exposure: { a2a: true, mcpTool: true }

items.name: echo
items.manifest:
apiVersion: garrison/v1
kind: Agent
metadata:
  name: echo
  description: Repeats its input; runs on the fake harness and costs nothing
spec:
  displayName: Echo
  exposure: { a2a: true, mcpTool: true }

items.name: planner-claude
items.manifest:
apiVersion: garrison/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: planner-claude
spec:
  agent: planner
  harnessProfile: builtin/claude-code
  model: sonnet
  maxTurns: 8
  timeoutSeconds: 300
  resources:
    secrets:
      - { alias: anthropic, secret: claude-credential }

items.name: coder-codex
items.manifest:
apiVersion: garrison/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: coder-codex
spec:
  agent: coder
  harnessProfile: builtin/codex
  maxTurns: 8
  timeoutSeconds: 300
  resources:
    secrets:
      - { alias: codex, secret: codex-credential }

items.name: echo-fake
items.manifest:
apiVersion: garrison/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: echo-fake
spec:
  agent: echo
  harnessProfile: builtin/fake
  timeoutSeconds: 60
  parameters:
    format: claude

items.name: claude-helper
items.manifest:
apiVersion: garrison/v1
kind: Agent
metadata:
  name: claude-helper
spec:
  displayName: Claude Helper
  description: General-purpose assistant running on Claude Code.
  exposure: { a2a: true, mcpTool: true }
  delegation: { maxDepth: 2, allow: [codex-coder, mux-helper] }

items.name: codex-coder
items.manifest:
apiVersion: garrison/v1
kind: Agent
metadata:
  name: codex-coder
spec:
  displayName: Codex Coder
  description: Coding assistant running on OpenAI Codex.
  exposure: { a2a: true, mcpTool: true }

items.name: mux-helper
items.manifest:
apiVersion: garrison/v1
kind: Agent
metadata:
  name: mux-helper
spec:
  displayName: Mux Helper
  description: Assistant running on Mux against an OpenAI-compatible model endpoint.
  exposure: { a2a: true, mcpTool: true }

items.name: claude-helper-default
items.manifest:
apiVersion: garrison/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: claude-helper-default
spec:
  agent: claude-helper
  harnessProfile: builtin/claude-code
  model: sonnet
  maxTurns: 8
  prompts:
    System: builtin/default-system
    Task: builtin/default-task
  resources:
    secrets:
      - { alias: anthropic, secret: claude-credential }
  timeoutSeconds: 600

items.name: codex-coder-default
items.manifest:
apiVersion: garrison/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: codex-coder-default
spec:
  agent: codex-coder
  harnessProfile: builtin/codex
  maxTurns: 8
  prompts:
    System: builtin/default-system
    Task: builtin/default-task
  resources:
    secrets:
      - { alias: codex, secret: codex-credential }
  timeoutSeconds: 600

items.name: mux-helper-default
items.manifest:
apiVersion: garrison/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: mux-helper-default
spec:
  agent: mux-helper
  harnessProfile: builtin/mux
  model: gpt-4o-mini
  maxTurns: 8
  parameters:
    baseUrl: http://127.0.0.1:9/v1
    adapterType: openai-compatible
    # Optional. The bootstrap removes these lines when MUX_CONTEXT_WINDOW or MUX_MAX_TOKENS is not set.
  prompts:
    System: builtin/default-system
    Task: builtin/default-task
  resources:
    secrets:
      - { alias: mux, secret: mux-api-key }
  timeoutSeconds: 600

items.name: mux-api-key
items.manifest:
apiVersion: garrison/v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: mux-api-key
  description: Declared by the bootstrap Job for the Mux sample deployment (no value)
spec:
  kind: GenericEnv

kind: Secret

  name: claude-credential

  kind: ClaudeCodeOAuthToken
